definition: Λευεί (indecl.) and Λευείς (Rec. -υΐ, -υΐς), genitive Λευεί, accusative -είν, ὁ (Heb. H3878)  Levi;  __1. the son of Jacob: Heb.7:5, 9, Rev.7:7.  __2. Son of Melchi: Luk.3:24.  __3. Son of Simeon: Luk.3:29.  __4. Son of Alphæus (cf. Μαθθαῖος): Mrk.2:14 (WH, mg., Ἰάκωβον), Luk.5:27, 29.† (AS)
